Manage data sharing with ServiceNow for generative AI model improvements.

By sharing your data with ServiceNow, you’re playing a valuable role in the evolution of more accurate AI systems that aim to enhance user experiences and better understand your business needs. The security framework around our data sharing is designed to keep your personal information confidential and private through rigorous protocols, anonymization, and careful handling during model training. To learn more, check out our FAQs. Manage who can opt-out of data sharing by assigning users to a Data Steward role. Check out the documentation to learn how to manage this role.
